channel.title: Tokenised Deposits in 2026: Banking Services, Stablecoin Competition, and the Status of Programmable Commercial Bank Money
channel.description: Tokenised deposit services in 2026 are moving from research into bank pilots and early client propositions. The status is still pre-scale, but the direction is clear: commercial bank money is being adapted for programmable settlement, digital wallets, stablecoin interoperability, and tokenised capital markets.

item.title: Tokenised Deposits in 2026: Banking Services, Stablecoin Competition, and the Status of Programmable Commercial Bank Money
item.description: The 2026 tokenised deposit status update — UK bank pilots, Lloyds digital wallets, stablecoin competition, BIS policy concerns, and programmable commercial bank money.
